# ONNX Runtime Notice DOX

## Purpose

- Retain the ONNX Runtime license text distributed with native release archives.

## Local Contracts

- Do not edit the upstream license text except when updating it from the authoritative dependency distribution.
- Runtime binaries are supplied by the pinned sherpa-onnx dependency and packaging scripts; this directory does not own binary source or build logic.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files.
